shorts_extract.hook: Why sleeping seven hours with a bedroom TV or hallway light on still disrupts your mood and heart rate through closed eyelids.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Burns et al. (2023/2024) 86,772-adult wrist light-sensor study + Mason & Zee (2022) 100-lux inpatient sleep trial.
shorts_extract.twist: Night light raised depression risk 30% independent of sleep hours—while bright outdoor daytime light cut risk 20%.
